newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to auction 10-yr JGBs on June 24 -- traders.
newsitem.headline: Japan to auction 10-yr JGBs on June 24 -- traders.

text.p: Japan's Ministry of Finance (MOF) is likely to offer 10-year Japanese government bonds (JGBs) through a price-competitive auction next Tuesday, traders said on Thursday.
This would be the first auction after MOF announced on Wednesday that it was suspending scandal-tainted Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd from JGB auctions and underwriting "for the time being".
MOF is also likely to offer two-year notes via an auction next Thursday, they said.
Judging from current market conditions, the coupon rate of the new 10-year JGBs is likely to be set at 2.6 percent, down from 2.7 percent for the most recent 196th 10-year issue, traders said.
"If the coupon rate is set at 2.6 percent, the new issue may eventually be merged with the 193rd 10-year JGB," a trader for a trust bank's securities unit said.
The 193rd 10-year JGBs were issued in February and March with a coupon rate of 2.6 percent.
